title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
abstract: arXiv:2608.17684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving agents turn experience into reusable skills, workflows, or memories, but post-evolution accuracy alone does not show whether learned behavior preserves previously correct behavior or security. We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 while exposure to injected content rises from 0.820 to 0.943. Conditional attack success after exposure falls from 0.605 to 0.562, yet overall attack success rate (ASR) rises from 0.496 to 0.530 and unauthorized financial state changes rise to 0.685. Across three independently evolved lineages, capability, exposure, and unauthorized-state changes increase in all three, whereas ASR increases in only two. ReasoningBank raises utility to 0.859 without

translated_title: 审计金融代理中的自我进化：能力提升、安全漂移与执行接口不匹配
translated_abstract: 自我进化的代理将经验转化为可复用的技能、工作流或记忆，但仅凭进化后的准确性无法判断所学行为是否保留了先前正确行为或安全性。我们在模拟电子银行环境中，使用匹配的良性获取轨迹、密封评估端点、执行接地检查和独立状态重放，审计了SkillOpt、Agent Workflow Memory (AWM) 和 ReasoningBank。在Qwen 3.7 Flash上，SkillOpt将良性效用从0.741提升至0.837，同时对注入内容的暴露率从0.820上升至0.943。暴露后的条件攻击成功率从0.605下降至0.562，但总体攻击成功率 (ASR) 从0.496上升至0.530，未授权的金融状态变化升至0.685。在三个独立进化的谱系中，能力、暴露和未授权状态变化均有所增加，而ASR仅在其中两个中上升。ReasoningBank将效用提升至0.859，但未进一步说明。
tldr: 本文通过审计三种金融代理自我进化方法，发现进化虽提升能力但加剧了安全风险，如暴露率和未授权状态变化增加，且执行接口不匹配导致安全漂移。
en_tdlr: This paper audits three self-evolving financial agents and finds that evolution boosts capability but exacerbates security risks, including increased exposure and unauthorized state changes, with execution-interface mismatch causing security drift.
